name: HarmonyOS Sans
note: Dialogue and native UI fonts. Both files are variable fonts (wght 40-900): text uses the default Regular instance, and the title menu and chapter title cards use the Bold instance (FontSource::weight). The files are not in the repository: the licence allows shipping them unmodified with the game but not distributing them separately. tools/content/prepare_fonts.py extracts them from the official archive after checking these hashes. Download the archive from the official design resources page; do not use third-party mirrors.
